input.name: Product name
input.qtyHint: Units in the shop's purchase order
input.nameRequired: Product name is required for export
input.maxPriceHint: Optional — prices above it are highlighted

tip.unitCostNote: Cost of one unit before profit and fees.
tip.floorNote: The lowest net unit price any regular combination may have — it leaves exactly the minimum profit.
tip.baseNote: Price of 1 unit for “{{customer}}” in “{{month}}” — the highest in the price list, no discounts. It is set so the deepest discount combination lands exactly on the minimum price.
tip.markupNote: How much you earn relative to what you paid for the goods. This is the markup of the base price, the highest in the price list — discounted combinations have less, the deepest only the minimum profit.
tip.marginNote: The share of the net price you keep as profit (after costs and fees). This is the margin of the base price, the highest in the price list — discounted combinations have less.

matrix.clickHint: Click a price to see how it is calculated or to change it. Drag with the right mouse button right / left to shift every price; with Ctrl only this combination; Shift: faster, Esc: cancel.
matrix.cellHint: In a cell: net per unit / per whole package, gross per unit / per package below.
matrix.cellHintAmount: In a cell: discount from this month's retail price — net per unit / per whole package, gross per unit and % below.
matrix.cellHintPercent: In a cell: discount in % of this month's retail price (not of the base price), the same discount net per unit / per whole package below.

details.smartUpdatesHint: Recalculate totals and profit after a manual edit
details.overridesCleared: {{count}} manual edits were cleared because the input or settings changed.

columnTips.profitPct: Markup = profit per unit ÷ purchase cost
columnTips.marginPct: Margin = profit per unit ÷ net unit price

edit.title: Change this price
edit.shiftHint: The change shifts all prices according to the discounts (except sale). Individually edited prices stay as they are.
edit.shiftSaleHint: The change shifts all sale prices according to the discounts.
edit.individualHint: Changes only this one combination. Gross and package totals are recalculated.
edit.shiftLinkedHint: Flexible price list: the change shifts all prices — sale and regular. When the full discounts do not fit between the minimum and the highest price, the discounts are reduced proportionally.
edit.snappedPackage: Rounded to {{total}} — a package price must be divisible by {{qty}} pcs ({{unit}} per unit).
edit.clampedMin: Raised to {{value}} per unit — the flexible price list never goes below the minimum price ({{min}}).
edit.clampedMinSale: Raised to {{value}} per unit — sale prices never go below the sale minimum ({{min}} = unit cost × sale factor).
edit.clampedMax: Lowered to {{value}} per unit — the flexible price list never exceeds the maximum price ({{max}}).
edit.clampedTopMin: Raised to {{value}} — the flexible price list never goes below the minimum price.
edit.clampedTopMax: Lowered to {{value}} — the base price cannot exceed the maximum price.
edit.clampedMaxSale: Lowered to {{value}} per unit — with the maximum price {{max}} sale prices do not exceed {{value}}.
edit.retailSelf: This is the retail price in {{month}}; this month's discounts are measured from it — {{relation}}.

breakdown.title: Why this price?
breakdown.subtitle: {{qty}} · {{customer}} · {{month}}
breakdown.fixedRounded: Rounded up from {{exact}} so the shop never under-recovers handling
breakdown.stale: Smart updates are off — the values below were not recalculated after the edit.
breakdown.grossTotal: Gross total (VAT on the net total)
breakdown.grossNotDivisible: Gross unit × quantity would be this — {{diff}} different, because VAT is calculated on the net total as on an invoice
breakdown.belowFloor: Below the minimum price {{threshold}} by this amount per unit
breakdown.belowSale: Below the sale minimum {{threshold}} by this amount per unit
breakdown.aboveMax: Above the maximum price {{max}} by this amount per unit
breakdown.flexTop: Flexible price list: highest price (no discount)
breakdown.flexPosition: Position between minimum price (0 %) and maximum price (100 %)
breakdown.feeUnit: − fee from the selling price ({{fee}} of gross)
breakdown.flexSaleLinked: Flexible price list: highest sale price = {{ratio}} of the highest price {{top}}
breakdown.flexLow: Flexible price list: lowest price (raised by an edit)

issues.title: Messages
issues.fixSettings: Fix these settings to see prices
issues.invalidNumber: Value must be a whole number of the smallest unit.
issues.valueTooHigh: Value is out of the supported range.
issues.vatUnusual: Unusual VAT rate — Polish rates are 0, 5, 8 and 23 %.
issues.tierQtyInvalid: Package size must be a whole number of at least 2.
issues.tierOrderError: Package {{b}} has a smaller discount than package {{a}}.
issues.tierOrderEqual: Packages {{a}} and {{b}} have the same discount.
issues.customerNone: Add at least one customer type.
issues.customerLabelEmpty: Customer type needs a name in both languages.
issues.customerOrderError: “{{b}}” has a smaller discount than “{{a}}” — list customers from smallest to largest discount.
issues.saleFactorRange: Sale factor must be above 0 and at most 1000 %.
issues.costNonPositive: Purchase cost must be greater than 0.
issues.outOfRange: Resulting prices exceed 10 000 000 PLN — check purchase cost and discounts.
issues.tierExceedsQty: Package {{tier}} exceeds the quantity bought ({{qty}}) — excluded.
issues.noTiers: No package discounts apply for quantity {{qty}}.
issues.fixedHandlingDominates: Fixed handling is {{perUnit}} per unit — {{share}} of the unit cost. Consider a larger quantity.
issues.retailProfitHigh: The markup at the base price is {{pct}} because the deepest discounts must still reach the minimum profit.
issues.saleBelowCost: Sale is below cost — the deepest sale combination loses {{loss}} per unit.
issues.saleAboveRegular: {{count}} sale prices are higher than the same combination in the cheapest regular month.
issues.staleRows: {{count}} rows were not recalculated after manual edits (smart updates are off).
issues.maxPriceNonPositive: Maximum price must be greater than 0.
issues.maxBelowFloor: Maximum price {{max}} is below the minimum price {{floor}} — no price can satisfy both.
issues.rowsAboveMax: {{count}} prices are above the maximum price {{max}}.
issues.monthNone: Add at least one month type.
issues.monthLabelEmpty: Month type needs a name in both languages.
issues.calendarUnknown: The calendar refers to a month type that does not exist.
issues.feeTooHigh: Fees including VAT cannot take 100 % of the price.
issues.flexActive: Flexible price list: the full discounts would need a base price of {{base}}, but the highest price is {{max}} — prices were spread between the minimum price and {{max}}.
issues.flexSaleActive: Flexible price list: sale prices were spread between the sale minimum and {{max}}.
issues.flexAtMinimum: The flexible price list never goes below the minimum price — the highest price was raised to {{floor}}, so all regular prices equal the minimum.
issues.flexLowRaised: Flexible price list: the lowest price was raised to {{low}} (highest {{max}}) — discounts were reduced so the edited price fits.
issues.amountPeakUnsettled: Amount discounts taken from the peak do not fit in the price of “{{month}}” — the largest one would be at least its whole price. The amounts were taken from the peak price at the percent-mode base, so in the peak they are a smaller % than the settings. Lower the discounts or enter the amounts by hand.
issues.amountTierOrder: The amount discount of the {{b}} pcs package is smaller than of {{a}} pcs ({{customer}}) — the larger package costs more per unit.
issues.amountCustomerOrder: “{{b}}” has a smaller amount discount than “{{a}}” ({{qty}} pcs package).

settings.handlingFixedHint: For the whole quantity bought, not per unit
settings.discountsHint: Discounts stack by multiplying. The deepest regular combination is priced exactly at the minimum price.
settings.saleFactorHintPercent: % of unit cost (100 % = sell at cost), net; VAT is added on top
settings.saleFactorHintMultiplier: × unit cost (1 = sell at cost), net; VAT is added on top
settings.calendarHint: Which month type applies in each calendar month — used to pre-select the current month.
settings.unsavedTip: Settings are remembered by the app and stay after a restart. They only differ from the configuration file last saved or loaded — save it if you want a backup or to move the settings to another computer.
settings.confirmDiscard: Loading a file replaces the current settings, which are not saved in a configuration file. Load anyway? (You can undo it with Ctrl+Z.)
settings.migrated: Configuration was converted from an older version ({{version}}).

loadError.notJson: The file is not valid JSON.
loadError.noVersion: The file is not an OTK Price Helper configuration (missing schemaVersion).
loadError.newerVersion: The file was created by a newer version of the app (schema {{version}}).
loadError.invalid: The file has invalid entries — nothing was changed:

settings.monthsHint: Your own names and discounts, e.g. summer and winter peak. Sale is set separately.
settings.feesHint: Of the gross price: marketplace, payments
settings.discountModeAmountHint: One table of PLN amounts (net per unit) shared by all month types, sale included: price = month price − amount. The amounts are generated from the % discounts below, taken from the peak month's retail price — there they equal the settings, in cheaper months they are a larger percentage. Change any amount in the calculator.

export.confirmErrors: {{count}} prices are below the minimum. Export anyway?
export.confirmStale: {{count}} rows were not recalculated after edits. Export anyway?

steps.productHint: What it costs and how many you buy

empty.title: Start with the product
empty.text: Enter the purchase cost and quantity — the price list for every package, customer and month appears right away.

flex.label: Flexible price list
flex.tooltip: When the full discounts do not fit under the highest price — the maximum price from step 1 or a manually lowered base price — prices are spread proportionally between the minimum price (deepest discount) and that highest price (no discount). Discounts are then smaller than configured. When the discounts fit, nothing changes.

xlsx.priceListNote: Left table: net prices per unit, right: gross per unit. Package value = unit price × quantity — full amounts are in the "All combinations" sheet.
xlsx.discountsNote: Applied discount = 1 − price ÷ highest price (base price; in flexible mode the maximum price; in sale the sale base). It differs from the nominal one because of rounding, manual edits and the flexible mode.

calc.fixedExact: Fixed handling per unit (exact, before rounding)
calc.feeRate: Fee as a share of the net price (fee × (1 + VAT))

xlsx.retailNote: Discounts are measured from the retail price of each month (1 unit · {{customer}}), not from the base price. Left table: net discount per unit in PLN, right: discount in % of that month's retail price. Under each month name: the retail price and how it differs from the base price.
xlsx.retailBelowTop: Below the base price (net, % of the base price)

amounts.title: Amount discounts
amounts.hint: Net amount per unit subtracted from the price of every month, sale included. Generated from the % discounts in the settings, taken from the peak month's retail price ({{month}}: {{retail}}). You can change any amount — the base price adjusts so the deepest combination still sits at the minimum price.
amounts.actualTitle: Actual reduction from the retail price:
amounts.actualNote: The flexible price list shrinks the discounts so they fit under the top price. Under each amount is the actual reduction from the retail price; hover for every month type.

scrub.hint: Drag with the right mouse button right / left to change the value (Shift: faster, Esc: cancel).
scrub.priceHint: Click to type. Drag with the right mouse button right / left: shifts every price, with Ctrl only this combination (Shift: faster, Esc: cancel).

update.installing: Installing version {{version}} — the app will restart in a moment. Your settings stay.
